tables.description: Flavor text for attempts a action
entries: A thunderous beat echoes as claws lash the air.
Its jaws widen, a discordant roar building in its throat.
It lowers into a crouch — muscles tense like coiled strings.
The dragon's tail whips around with a resounding crack.
Lightning arcs from its maw in jagged, rhythmic bursts.
Claw tips rake the ground as it lunges forward.
A subsonic hum vibrates its scales, rising to a crescendo.
Its wings flare open, creating a wind that howls like an instrument.
The dragon's eyes narrow into slits of icy blue fire.
It rears back, preparing to bring the full force of its bite down.
Claws click against stone as it adjusts its stance.
A deep, resonant hum reverberates through its chest cavity.
Lightning dances along the edges of its claws, crackling in time with a heartbeat.
Its tail sweeps across the battlefield like an orchestra conductor's baton.
The dragon's roar peaks and then cuts off abruptly as it strikes.
Wings flap in perfect sync, lifting it into position for a devastating aerial attack.
A shudder runs through its body — electricity building to be unleashed.
Its jaws open wide enough to swallow a horse whole.
Claws extend fully, revealing razor-sharp tips glinting like polished steel.
It coils back on itself, gathering momentum for a strike that will shake the earth.

tables.description: Flavor text for successes a action
entries: Lightning spears forth from its maw in perfect rhythm with each step.
Its bite connects — teeth sinking deep into flesh, drawing blood.
Claw tips find purchase and tear through armor like parchment.
A thunderous crash as its tail smashes into a wall of rock.
The dragon's roar shatters a crystal formation on the cavern ceiling.
Its jaws close around its prey with an audible snap, bones cracking beneath its teeth.
Lightning dances across the battlefield in syncopated bursts, searing everything it touches.
A clawed hand shoots out and grasps a fleeing foe by the throat.
The ground quakes as the dragon's massive form lands after a devastating aerial assault.
Its bite leaves a cauterized wound, flesh sizzling where its teeth met skin.
Claw marks gouge deep into the earth, kicking up clouds of dust and debris.
A subsonic boom emanates from its chest as it unleashes a breath weapon.
Its tail wraps around a fallen enemy, constricting with inexorable force.
The dragon's roar resolves into an eerie, haunting melody that echoes through the halls.
Wings beat in rapid succession, sending gusts of wind buffeting everything in their path.
Lightning arcs from its claws to its maw and back again, completing a circuit of destruction.
Its bite severs a limb cleanly, the separated appendage still twitching on the ground.
A clawed hand obliterates an obstacle, reducing it to rubble in seconds.
The dragon's roar grows louder with each passing moment — a crescendo of pure destructive power.
Its breath weapon engulfs everything in its path, leaving only scorched earth behind.

tables.description: Flavor text for failures a action
entries: A discordant note hangs in the air as its roar fizzles out unfinished.
Claw tips scrape harmlessly against stone, sparks flying from the impact.
Its tail lashes wildly but connects with nothing but empty space.
Lightning arcs from its maw — but dissipates into mist before reaching its target.
A subsonic hum emanates from its scales, building to a crescendo... and then stopping abruptly.
The dragon's jaws snap shut on air, teeth clicking together painfully.
Its wings beat too hard, sending it careening off course mid-dive.
Claw tips rake through the dirt as they miss their mark, leaving behind shallow furrows.
A roar builds in its throat — but comes out as a strangled cough instead of destructive force.
The dragon's bite connects... with nothing but a mouthful of stone and dust.
Its tail sweeps across the battlefield — and knocks over an ally by mistake.
Lightning crackles from its claws, only to fizzle out impotently against a shield.
A deep hum reverberates through its chest cavity... before fading into silence.
The dragon's jaws open wide — but the prey escapes at the last second.
It lunges forward with all its might... and stumbles over its own tail, falling flat on its face.
Claw tips gouge deep into the earth — but only because it missed the real target entirely.
Its roar reaches a fever pitch... and then trails off awkwardly as the moment passes.
The dragon's breath weapon misses its mark — instead scorching the ground at its own feet.
It coils back to strike... and loses balance, tumbling head over tail into a pile of rubble.
Claw tips rake across an opponent's armor, leaving only scratches in their wake.

tables.description: Flavor text for attempts a attack
entries: Its jaws stretch wide, scales parting to reveal a forked tongue, tasting the air.
A sudden lunge — lightning crackles from its maw like an errant note in a symphony of force.
It rears up, tail lashing, before diving down in a thunderous arc.
Claws scrape against stone as it gathers itself for a pouncing strike.
Muscles tense beneath iridescent scales, power coiling and ready to unleash.
A deep inhale, lungs expanding like bellows, charging the air with static electricity.
Eyes narrow to slits, fixing on its target with predatory intensity.
It opens its wings wide, a flash of sapphire against storm clouds, then folds them tight for impact.
A low growl reverberates through the cavern, resonating in the dragon's chest as it readies its assault.
Scales shimmer and ripple like a struck gong as it prepares to strike.
It circles its prey, head darting, always moving to the beat of some unheard rhythm.
Jaws snap shut with an echoing crack that sends reverberations through the ground.
A sudden pivot on one claw-tipped foot, repositioning for a devastating side swipe.
Its roar builds like a crescendo, scales vibrating in harmony until it reaches a deafening peak.
It coils around its target, squeezing with serpentine strength before the final bite.
Tail lashes through the air, scattering sparks as it draws back for another attack.
A deep inhale — the sound of a windstorm trapped in its lungs, ready to unleash lightning.
Claws dig into earth or stone, anchoring it as it leans forward, jaws gaping wide.
Its wings beat once, twice, propelling it through the air in a blur of sapphire and storm gray.
A sudden freeze — every muscle taut, every scale electric with anticipation before the strike.

tables.description: Flavor text for successes a attack
entries: Lightning cracks between its teeth as they close around flesh, searing and rending.
Jaws clamp down with the force of a thunderclap, bones shattering beneath dragonfire breath.
The bite connects — a jolt of electricity surges through scales and into yielding meat.
Its fangs sink deep, tearing free chunks of fur or hide as it shakes its head violently.
A crunch echoes through the chamber, followed by the sizzle of lightning on bloodied flesh.
It releases its grip with a triumphant roar that rattles the very stones around them.
The creature's struggles cease abruptly, limp in the dragon's jaws as it savors victory.
Its tongue flicks out, tasting copper and ozone mingling on its prey's torn body.
A guttural growl of satisfaction vibrates through its chest as it swallows the first mouthful.
Lightning arcs between its eyes and the gaping wound in a macabre dance of power.
It tosses its head back, sending bits of flesh flying like confetti in a grotesque celebration.
The smell of burnt hair and ozone fills the air as it crushes its victim between fangs and claws.
Its jaws work methodically, grinding bone to dust before gulping down another mouthful.
A sudden jerk of its head — the sound of tearing flesh punctuated by a final, dying squeal.
It pauses, savoring the taste of blood and fear on its forked tongue before finishing the kill.
Its claws rake across the ground, gouging deep furrows as it shakes its prey like a rag doll.
The dragon's chest swells with pride — scales glowing with an inner fire of conquest.
It lets out a bellowing laugh that echoes through the cavern, a symphony of dominance and bloodlust.
Its wings unfurl to their full span, casting a shadow over the slain creature as it claims its prize.

tables.description: Flavor text for failures a attack
entries: Jaws snap shut on empty air — teeth clack together with a discordant clash.
A lightning bolt crackles from its maw, arcing harmlessly into the ground at its feet.
It lunges forward, overbalancing in its haste and stumbling awkwardly past its target.
Its fangs scrape against leather or chainmail — sparks fly but no damage is done.
A sudden jerk of its head sends a chunk of stone flying instead of the intended prey.
The dragon's strike connects, but its teeth glance off bone rather than biting deep.
It roars in frustration as its victim slips free at the last moment — lightning dissipates into mist.
Its jaws clamp down on air — only a mouthful of scales and tongue greet it inside its maw.
A quick lateral dodge by its prey leaves the dragon's fangs snapping shut on nothing but wind.
The creature leaps high, wings spreading wide, but a gust of wind knocks it off course.
Its claws rake across stone or armor — sparks fly, but no flesh is torn.
A sudden lurch forward sends the dragon stumbling into its own tail, tripping itself up.
It opens its mouth to roar — lightning crackles uselessly between its teeth instead of striking true.
The bite connects, but its fangs catch in hide or fur, and it can't wrench them free.
A momentary distraction causes it to hesitate mid-strike — the window of opportunity closes abruptly.
Its tail lashes wildly, smashing into stalagmites instead of crushing its foe as intended.
It charges forward only to hit a wall or rock formation, stunned and off-balance.
The dragon's breath catches in its throat at a crucial moment — lightning sputters out weakly.
Its wings beat furiously but fail to gain altitude, leaving it grounded and vulnerable.
A sudden surge of electricity arcs between its teeth — pain forces its jaws apart prematurely.

tables.description: Flavor text for crits with Bite
entries: Its jaws snap shut with a thunderclap, fangs driving deep into flesh.
The bite lands like the first note of a symphony — sudden, sharp, resounding.
Lightning arcs between its teeth, crackling in time with its pulse.
It lunges from the shadows, scales glinting like polished sapphire.
A whip-crack snap as its neck extends, targeting your jugular.
The dragon's head rears back, then plunges down with brutal precision.
Its roar echoes like a discordant chord, vibrating in your bones.
Electricity dances across the air between you, drawn to the strike's point of impact.
With a deft flick of its tongue, it tastes the air — and targets your scent trail.
The bite comes swift as a plucked string on an enormous harp.
It coils back, then unleashes a torrent of lightning with each chomp of its jaws.
Fangs tear through fabric and hide, drawing blood in perfect rhythm.
Its scales ripple like waves before the strike, building momentum.
A chord of thunder rings out as its teeth meet their mark.
It weaves its head side-to-side, bite flashing faster than sight can track.
The dragon's tail lashes back, propelling it into a devastating charge.
Its mouth opens wide — an abyss of fangs and electricity ready to swallow you whole.
Each snap of its jaws leaves a mark in time with the beat of your heart.
It lunges from behind, jaws clamping down on your shoulder blade.
The bite lands like a hammer blow, knocking you off balance.

tables.description: Flavor text for fumbles with Bite
entries: Its jaws snap shut on empty air — teeth clash together with a discordant clang.
A roar turns into a sputter of sparks, coughing out a sour note.
It lunges, but its claws catch in the folds of its own scales, stumbling forward.
The bite lands short, lightning crackling harmlessly at the target's feet.
Its tail whips too hard, cracking against a stalactite with a resounding shatter.
A deep inhale for flame falters mid-breath — smoke chokes it into a fit of coughing.
It snaps its neck to bite, scales vibrating off-key as the head overshoots its target.
Claws swipe through the air in wide arcs but never connect, leaving trails of ozone scent.
A leap ends in an awkward stumble, limbs tangling mid-air before it crashes into the ground.
It roars a challenge, but the sound warbles and cracks like a broken lute string.
Its wings flap hard, stirring up debris that clouds its vision just as it attacks.
A backhand swat meant for a foe only knocks over a pile of hoarded instruments instead.
Teeth sink into flesh — but not deep enough; the creature's head jerks to one side too soon.
It charges, only to trip on its own tail in an undignified sprawl.
A claw meant for slashing catches on rough stone, ripping out a scale with a wince of pain.
Lightning arcs from its maw, but fizzles out before reaching its target in a sparking sputter.
Its jaws open wide to roar — only to inhale dust instead. It coughs violently, head snapping back.
A swipe at an enemy misses, sending a nearby instrument flying with a discordant twang.
It lashes out blindly, tail smashing into the wall in a spray of rock and echoing thunder.

tables.description: Flavor text for barely_hits with Bite
entries: Its fang catches on the last moment — a sliver of tooth glints past.
A clap of lightning's thunder nearly drowns out its hiss as it lands, close but not quite enough to sting.
The tip grazes, just barely, like a harp string plucked too soft to ring.
It strikes at an angle that shouldn't work — and somehow does, by the narrowest margin.
A flick of its tail saves it from overswinging; the bite connects with a glancing touch.
Its jaws snap shut mere inches away, lightning crackling between them like a failed arpeggio.
The attack skims past, close enough to feel the heat of its breath but not its teeth.
It lunges late — and lands early, catching skin instead of bone in a shallow nick.
A beat too slow, it snaps at empty air. The next heartbeat brings its fangs to flesh.
Its roar turns discordant as its bite misses the target by a hair's breadth.
It swings wide; the tip catches an edge and digs in with a rasp of scale on hide.
The dragon's maw opens, a chasm of teeth that closes just short of crushing down.
Lightning sparks off its scales as its jaws miss their mark by millimeters.
A scrape, not quite a strike — the force of the failed blow still shudders through them both.
Its fangs barely graze, like a bowstring drawn too tight and released too soon.
The bite catches on bone in a glancing blow that sends vibrations up its spine.
It lunges and connects — but not quite hard enough to leave a mark; a feather-light touch of teeth.
A near miss, the wind from its jaws ruffling fur as it pulls back, unsatisfied.
Its bite clips an edge of armor in a sparking slide of metal on tooth.
It snaps and misses — but not by much. The air still sings with the speed of its strike.

tables.description: Flavor text for barely_misses with Bite
entries: Its jaws clack shut millimetres from flesh, lightning snapping between teeth.
The target's heart thrums against its ribs, a drumbeat matching the dragon's thunderous approach.
Scales brush skin like static electricity, raising goosebumps as it pulls back just shy of contact.
A discordant roar vibrates through bone, the soundwave so powerful hair whips backwards from its maw.
Its talons click together with a precision that echoes the snap of fingers inches away from a throat.
The dragon's haunch muscles ripple beneath iridescent scales, coiled energy poised to explode into motion.
Lightning arcs across the sky in time with the dragon's head snapping forward — and stops short of its target's face.
A subsonic hum builds in its chest cavity, resonating through the earth and up the legs of those nearby.
Its tail lashes out in a blur of motion, close enough to stir dust but never quite touching.
The dragon's forked tongue flicks out to taste the air, just grazing the sweat on a cheek before retracting.
Bite marks appear on the ground inches from feet, deep indentations hinting at what could've been.
Its wings beat down in a rhythmic gust that tousles hair and ruffles clothing — without quite knocking anyone over.
The dragon's eyes narrow to slits, pupils dilating as it focuses intently on a point just beyond its target's nose.
A claw traces an invisible line across skin, leaving a trail of tingling energy in its wake without breaking the surface.
Its roar crescendos into a wall of sound that pushes against eardrums, holding them hostage for a breathless moment.
The ground splits beneath feet from the force of the dragon's impact as it lands — but doesn't quite crack open to swallow them whole.
Lightning dances across its scales in patterns that mirror the target's racing pulse, never quite connecting.
Its forked tongue darts out again, this time tracing a path along an arm without actually touching clothing or skin.
The dragon's talons click together with metronomic precision, each sound echoing like a countdown to impact — but it never comes.

tables.description: Flavor text for miss_dodge with Bite
entries: It bends backward, scales flashing as the blade slices empty air.
A rhythmic sidestep sends the weapon glancing off its flank.
Muscle ripples beneath gleaming hide — a fluid dodge that outpaces the strike.
Its roar shatters the silence in jagged chords of evasion.
Quick feet tap out an intricate beat, carrying it just beyond reach.
A sudden duck, and the projectile sails harmlessly overhead.
Scales ripple like water as it flows sideways through the attack's path.
Eyes narrow to slits — a lightning-fast twist of the neck avoids the blow.
The strike passes so close that its wake stirs the dragon's mane.
It dances away, hooves clicking out a counterpoint to the missed swing.
A subsonic hum vibrates through scales, warning of impending evasion.
Its tail lashes behind like a metronome as it sidesteps at the last instant.
Muscle and sinew coil — then spring into a graceful, avoidance-bound leap.
The attack cuts through empty space with a discordant clash of steel.
It weaves between incoming blows like an agile conductor directing chaos.
A sharp turn on the ball of one foot brings it outside the weapon's arc.
Lightning crackles in time with its evasive steps — a dance of defiance.
The dragon's scales part and shimmer, revealing only air behind them.
It pirouettes away from danger with the precision of an expert musician.
A sudden gust ruffles its mane as it ducks into the eye of a wind-spun vortex.

tables.description: Flavor text for miss_armor with Bite
entries: Armor vibrates like a tuning fork, deflecting lightning-fast fangs.
Sparks leap from the dragon's jaws where they meet unyielding steel.
The bite crashes against plate like a discordant chord — and falters.
Ringing metal echoes the dragon's frustrated roar of static.
Blade skitters off scale, showering sparks that dance to a silent beat.
Thunder strikes armor, only for the impact to dissipate harmlessly.
Steel sings as fangs glance off — a defiant note in the cacophony.
Armor hums with a subsonic thrum at the aborted bite's force.
The dragon's snout meets plate — a jarring clash of elemental powers.
Sparks arc between fang and steel, illuminating armor in strobe-flashes.
A dull clang as jaw connects — then slides away with a hiss of frustration.
Armor groans under the bite's pressure but holds firm against the strain.
The dragon's scales shimmer like a struck gong, absorbing the blow.
Fangs meet plate in a sizzling clash, lightning crackling between them.
A sharp clang rings out as steel and scale collide head-on.
Sparks rain from armor's shoulder as fangs skitter off its surface.
The dragon's jaw snaps shut on empty air — the bite deflected cleanly.
Armor flexes under the impact, its links humming with deflective resonance.
A sparking impact sends lightning dancing across plate in jagged lines.
Fangs connect with a resonant clang — armor rings like a struck bell.

tables.description: Flavor text for killing_blow with Bite
entries: Its maw yawns wide, a portal to oblivion — one last roar like a symphony's final chord.
A bite that severs not just flesh but the strings of fate itself, with a resounding snap.
The dragon's jaws close around empty air; the music of its fury fades to silence.
Lightning arcs from its teeth, painting an X on the target — a decisive, electric crosshairs.
Its bite finds purchase, and the world seems to hold its breath for that one, awful moment before release.
The dragon's scales shudder like taut drumheads as it strikes, unleashing a final, thunderous note.
One last chord reverberates through the air — the clash of teeth on bone, music's bloody end.
It lunges in a final, discordant crescendo; jaws close with the force of a collapsing universe.
A bite that carries not just tooth and claw, but the full weight of an existence unraveling.
The dragon's jaws meet flesh with a sickening, satisfying thud — the period on its symphonic death sentence.

tables.description: Flavor text for attempts a attack
entries: Its claws rake the air in a discordant screech of steel on scales.
It coils like a spring — every muscle tense, lightning crackling at its joints.
With a roar that shatters stone, it lunges, talons extended and snapping shut.
A whirlwind of sapphire and silver as it spins in place, striking out in all directions.
The ground trembles under the thunderous impact of its charge, claws bared.
It rears up, scales shimmering like a waterfall of blue glass, then crashes down.
A symphony of violence — each claw swipe timed to the rhythm of its heartbeat.
Its talons drag across stone, leaving scorched lines in their wake as it advances.
It crouches low, coiled energy vibrating through every scale, ready to explode into motion.
The air splits with a crack of lightning that mirrors the strike of its claws.
Its claw extends with a lightning-fast, rhythmic flick.
The dragon's body twists as its talons slash through the air.
A precise, staccato movement — scales ripple in anticipation.
Its claws rake the air in a blinding crescendo of scales and sinew.
A lightning-quick slash, teeth bared as it lunges from the shadows.
It coils like a spring, every muscle taut with unleashed potential.
The talons carve through the ether, leaving shockwave contrails.
A rhythmic dance of limbs, each strike timed to subsonic beats.
Its roar splits the sky as it descends in a clawed arc of thunder.
The ground trembles under its charge, claws gouging furrows.

tables.description: Flavor text for successes a attack
entries: A screech like shattered glass echoes as its claws find flesh and tear.
Sapphire scales glisten red, dripping gore from freshly torn wounds.
Its talons plunge deep, scales vibrating with a bass thrum of satisfaction.
A wet crunch signals the shattering of bone beneath its relentless grip.
It rips away a chunk of hide, leaving an exposed wound that smokes and sizzles.
Flesh yields to its claws in a spray of arterial red that paints its scales.
Its claws move in precise patterns — each strike calculated, brutal, and efficient.
A guttural roar rises from its throat as it tastes the copper tang of blood.
Its talons slice through muscle like knives through butter, leaving a gaping wound.
It twists its claws free with a wet slurp, tearing more flesh in the process.
Claws rip through armor like it was paper, sparks flying from torn metal.
The impact sends a harmonic shudder down the dragon's limb.
Blood blooms where talons meet flesh, a vivid splash of crimson against blue scales.
Lightning crackles from its fingertips as they tear through flesh.
A discordant chord echoes as talons find purchase and rip.
Sinew snaps like a taut string as it wrenches its arm back.
The thunderous impact vibrates up its limbs, resonating in bone.
Its claws draw a symphony of screams from the vanquished foe.
A burst of sparks illuminates the gore-slicked talons mid-pull.
The lightning-hued blood runs down its scales like fresh paint.

tables.description: Flavor text for failures a attack
entries: Claws scrape harmlessly against armor — a metallic screech of wasted effort.
The strike goes wide, sending blue sparks flying where stone chips under impact.
It overreaches and stumbles, talons gouging deep into its own side in the fall.
A misstep sends it sliding off balance, its claws missing their target by inches.
Its talons collide with each other mid-strike — a discordant clank of frustration.
It lunges too soon and catches only air, nearly impaling itself on its own momentum.
The strike glances off a shoulder blade, leaving shallow scratches instead of deep gouges.
It bites the dust as its claws sink into soft earth rather than enemy flesh.
A hasty swipe sends it overcompensating — it nearly topples from the force of its own swing.
Its talons scrape against bone but can't find purchase, slipping away uselessly.
The swiping claws find only air as momentum throws it off-balance.
Its aim is true but the target shifts; talons scrape harmlessly on stone.
A discordant clang rings out as metal guards deflect its strike, sending vibrations through its arm.
Claws scrabble against stone where it expected yielding flesh.
The blade meets only air, and it stumbles into an off-balance spin.
Its talons scrape leather with a discordant screech of metal on hide.
A wet thud: its strike lands in the wrong place, in the wrong way.
It overreaches, leaving itself open as its momentum carries on.
The lightning crackles uselessly, scorching empty ground.
Its claws sink into earth where they should have found bone.

tables.description: Flavor text for crits with Claw
entries: Its claws flash, lightning-bright and thunder-quick.
The strike's force sends shockwaves rippling through the air.
It lunges with a fluid grace, like a dancer spinning into a kick.
A resonant hum builds in its throat, crescendoing as it strikes.
Its scales vibrate sympathetically, echoing the blow's impact.
The music of destruction — shattering bone and cracking leather.
It arches backward, then snaps forward with whip-crack speed.
Sparks fly from its claws, arcing like fireworks against the night sky.
Its roar builds to a discordant climax just as it slashes down.
The force of the strike sends debris spiraling in all directions.
It coils, then unleashes in one devastating, musical motion.
The air shimmers from the kinetic energy behind its claws.
Its eyes blaze with an electric intensity as it lunges forward.
The strike lands with a thunderous crack, like a gong being sounded.
It spins on its axis, lashing out with both claws in tandem.
The attack's rhythm is primal, the dragon's version of a war drum.
Its scales ripple and flex as it channels raw power into the strike.
A shockwave blossoms from the point of impact, pushing all aside.
It strikes so hard that the earth trembles beneath its claws.
The blow lands with a resounding thump, like a heavy bass note.

tables.description: Flavor text for fumbles with Claw
entries: Its claws scrape sparks from stone, missing flesh by inches.
The dragon's wings catch a updraft, sending it spinning sideways.
It roars — discordant, off-key — as its tail cracks against a boulder.
A lightning bolt sizzles between its jaws but finds no target.
Its talons scrape the dirt, struggling to regain footing.
The dragon's scales hum with subsonic vibrations that make the earth tremble — and misstep it.
It snaps its jaws shut on empty air, teeth clacking together painfully.
A rhythmic crackle of lightning builds up, fizzling out before striking home.
Its hind legs slip on loose gravel, sending it staggering forward awkwardly.
The dragon's claws dig into the ground, throwing dirt instead of drawing blood.
A discordant roar turns into a splutter as its breath fails mid-shout.
It lunges with a flourish — overbalancing and stumbling past its mark.
The scales on its belly quiver in anticipation, but nothing connects.
Its tail lashes out, snapping against the wind instead of its foe.
A subsonic hum builds to an awkward whine as it adjusts stance mid-swing.
It beats wings furiously — lifting debris but not itself high enough.
The dragon's lightning dances across its own hide, singeing scales harmlessly.
Its claws scrape against a shield, unable to penetrate the metal's surface.
A thunderous roar builds in its chest — then catches as it misjudges distance.
It rears back for a mighty strike — only to overreach and lose balance.

tables.description: Flavor text for barely_hits with Claw
entries: Its claw's edge glances off a rib — a hair away from shattering.
A lightning strike misjudged by inches, searing air instead of flesh.
The tail lashes and catches a sleeve, unraveling threads but not skin.
Claw scrapes armor where it meets throat, leaving a dented line.
Wings beat too close, their gust nearly knocking the blade off target.
A thunderous roar makes the ground shudder — almost throwing its strike wide.
The beak snaps shut on empty space as prey twitches aside at the last second.
Talons scrabble against stone inches from a leg, sending sparks and echoes.
The dragon's lightning cracks across the shield — scraping but not breaking it.
A wing buffet sends a bolt of energy spinning into the ground beside the target.
Claw rakes down the back of a shoulder blade, raising goosebumps but no blood.
Its breath washes over the attacker in a wave of near-fatal heat.
The dragon's tail sweeps through the spot where an enemy stood a heartbeat ago.
A lightning strike misses its mark and sears the air inches above their head.
Claw catches a strap, slicing it — but the wearer jerks free in time.
The dragon's roar shakes loose a cascade of pebbles that sting like hail.
It snaps at empty space, teeth grazing a lock of hair as the target ducks away.
A lightning bolt lances through the air and sears the ground beside the runner.
Its claw catches a fold in cloth — tearing it but missing the flesh beneath.
The dragon's wing beats too close to an attacker — the wind's gust nearly unbalancing them.

tables.description: Flavor text for barely_misses with Claw
entries: Its claw sings past flesh — a discordant note that makes the air quiver.
The strike's shadow darkens the target's cheekbone, but no more.
So near it shivers: scales grazing skin without breaking contact.
A lightning flash splits the air millimeters from an eye socket.
Roar and swipe align perfectly — almost touching the throat.
Claw-tips catch the light a hair's breadth before scraping bone.
The target flinches at the sudden rush of displaced air alone.
Its lightning arcs in syncopation, missing by millimeters and centimeters.
A scale brushes an eyebrow — electric and unyielding, then gone.
Thunder rumbles from its maw as claws pass by a hair's width.
The strike is so close it tugs at the target's clothing in passing.
Claw-tips part strands of hair — a static charge lifting them briefly.
Its scales vibrate with tension, humming against the target's skin without touching.
A discordant roar harmonizes perfectly with the near-miss swipe.
The strike leaves a phantom imprint on the air, visible for an instant.
Claw and throat align so closely that the target holds its breath alone.
Its lightning crackles in time to the heartbeat it almost stops.
So near the scent of ozone fills the nostrils — a warning unheeded.
The swipe's afterimage lingers, blurring the edge of vision for an instant.
A scale's edge catches the light like a blade, missing by millimeters.

tables.description: Flavor text for miss_dodge with Claw
entries: It ducks with serpentine grace, the blow passing overhead.
Quick as thought, its scales shimmer just out of reach.
Flowing like a river around an obstacle, it escapes unscathed.
The strike glances off empty space — no contact made.
A rhythmic twist carries it aside in time to the discordant roar.
Slipping through openings too small for the attack's bulk.
It sidesteps with musical precision, avoiding every swipe.
Lightning crackles from its scales as it dances away untouched.
